description: This file defines a configuration class and transformation methods for handling requests and responses for the `qwen3` model within the Amazon Bedrock deployment environment. It includes methods to convert message formats, map parameters, and process API responses specific to the `qwen3` model, extending base configurations and implementing format-specific transformations.

classes.name: AmazonQwen3Config
classes.description: Configuration class for sending `qwen3` requests to the Bedrock `/invoke/` endpoint, including parameter handling and message transformation methods tailored for Qwen3's request and response formats.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI API parameters supported by this configuration.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default OpenAI parameters into the optional_params dictionary, to be used in requests.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms OpenAI formatted messages and parameters into a Qwen3-specific request payload.

methods.name: str _convert_messages_to_prompt(self, messages: List[AllMessageValues])
methods.description: Converts a list of OpenAI message objects to a Qwen3 prompt string, handling role-specific formatting, tool calls, and multimodal content.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Processes the Raw response from Qwen3, extracting generated content and mapping it into the standard ModelResponse structure, handling response cleanup and usage info.
